cinematic_dialogue:2:1410730001:.text: Drink it. The spring water from the surface.
cinematic_dialogue:2:1410730001:.source_cn: 喝下吧，这地表清澈的泉水……

say:4:1410730101:0.text: Do you see now? This is Misarte's curse.
say:4:1410730101:0.source_cn: 看到了吗？这就是弥萨忒的诅咒。

say:5:1410730102:0.text: Absurd, isn't it? This pristine water, the simplest gift in all the world, is the very source of our clan's curse.
say:5:1410730102:0.source_cn: 多么讽刺啊……地表的清水，这世间最普通的恩赐，却是我族...

say:6:1410730103:0.text: It begins with unbearable pain, followed by madness, and eventually... the emergence of a mindless monster.
say:6:1410730103:0.source_cn: 一开始是剧痛，随后是疯狂，最后……沦为失去理智的怪物。

say:7:1410730104:0.text: Two millennia past, I led the fiercest of our clan from our homeland, and yet... fewer than one in ten reached Sal'thorin alive.
say:7:1410730104:0.source_cn: 两千年前，我带领着最骁勇的绿裔战士们离开故土，可最终…...

say:8:1410730105:0.text: Yet, fortune smiled upon us this time, and I found a dragon—or, more precisely, the slumbering form of the Primordial Dragon.
say:8:1410730105:0.source_cn: 命运此时却再度眷顾了我们，我找到了龙，准确地说，是沉睡...

say:9:1410730106:0.text: I do not know why it rests here, but I pray it never awakens.
say:9:1410730106:0.source_cn: 我不知道它为何在此沉睡，但我希望它永远不要醒来。

say:10:1410730107:0.text: Because the power of dragons is enough to challenge even the gods. With the Primordial Dragon, we, the Essail, shall no longer suffer the curse of Misarte!
say:10:1410730107:0.source_cn: 因为龙之力足以与神明相抗，利用初始之龙，艾塞勒将再也不...

say:11:1410730108:0.text: The Primordial Dragon's power was beyond my grasp, but I did not falter. Instead, I seized control of the magic and life force contained within the dragon eggs.
say:11:1410730108:0.source_cn: 但初始之龙的力量太过强大，难以驾驭。我不得不退而求其次...

say:12:1410730109:0.text: After countless failures, I triumphed. The Divine Dew was finally brought into existence.
say:12:1410730109:0.source_cn: 经过千百次的失败，我成功了。恩典灵露，终于诞生了。

say:13:1410730110:0.text: Do you believe I am simply boasting of my accomplishments? No...
say:13:1410730110:0.source_cn: 你们以为我在夸耀自己的功绩吗？不——

say:14:1410730111:0.text: The Divine Dew is the salvation I forged with my own hands, not a gift from the gods, but from me alone...
say:14:1410730111:0.source_cn: 恩典灵露是我亲手酿造的救赎。不靠神明，而是我——

say:15:1410730112:0.text: Now, the Essail rises with new life!
say:15:1410730112:0.source_cn: 赐予了艾塞勒一族的新生！

say:16:1410730113:0.text: At this moment, you shall witness the power of divine grace with your own eyes.
say:16:1410730113:0.source_cn: 此刻，就让你们亲眼见证恩典的力量。

say:17:1410730114:0.text: Give this one the Divine Dew. Let the other show you...
say:17:1410730114:0.source_cn: 给这一位灵露。而另一位，就让他向诸位展示——

say:18:1410730115:0.text: ...the fate of those forsaken by the divine.

cinematic_dialogue:21:1410730001:.text: Drink it. The spring water from the surface.
cinematic_dialogue:21:1410730001:.source_cn: 喝下吧，这地表清澈的泉水……

narration:23:14010725:0.text: The two Essail drink from the surface water, and their forms start to warp with corruption. The Divine Dew saves one, but the other succumbs to the dark transformation, only to be struck down by Thador's hand.
narration:23:14010725:0.source_cn: 两个艾塞勒喝下地表清水后开始孽化，其中一个摄入了恩典灵...
